subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Synthetic Identity Fraud
description: A fast breakdown of Synthetic Identity Fraud for builders.

hook.text: A criminal creates a fake person using a real child's Social Security number and a made-up name.

buildup.text: Synthetic identity fraud combines real and fake data to create identities that pass verification checks.

discovery.text: It's the fastest-growing financial crime in America, costing lenders over $6 billion per year.

twist.text: Children and immigrants are the most common victims — people who don't check their credit reports regularly.

climax.text: A person who doesn't exist can open accounts, build credit, and disappear — leaving real victims behind.

punchline.text: A fake person. A real child's stolen number.

quiz.question: What is synthetic identity fraud?
options: Combining real and fake data to create an identity that passes verification
